claims.text: The semantic census reads committed blobs pinned to ebe862b and covers all 12,856 tracked paths without reading working-tree content.

Static parsing was attempted for all 3,721 committed Python blobs without importing project modules: 3,711 parsed normally, four required fallback parsing because of invalid type comments, and six legacy reference blobs failed parsing.
Hybrid training flows from the external pipeline CLI through trainer.train and TrainingSession into dataset, model, optimizer, and epoch execution.
Hybrid and quantization both expose a top-level package named src while hybrid scripts also inject a repository path at runtime.
quantization/src/artifact_patch.py defines two public functions twice without aliasing the earlier implementations.
Two dated hardware update modules perform file reads and writes at import time.
Four maintained hardware functions span 908 to 1,954 lines.

The size, branch structure, and statements in the four large hardware functions indicate mixed validation, orchestration, I/O, and rendering responsibilities that should be characterized before decomposition.
The active hardware behavioral source of truth is HLS C++ rather than the placeholder RTL directory.
The unrelated src namespaces and path injection can select the wrong package when hybrid and quantization share one interpreter environment.

Repository governance should retain references permanently in-repository with provenance and relationship manifests; externalization or deletion review applies only to separately approved non-reference binaries.
Whether deployed environments currently install hybrid and quantization into the same Python environment is not established.
External consumers of current src imports, CLI JSON schemas, reference paths, and hardware artifact paths have not been enumerated.
